audit_items.proof_trace: In genuine bad-debt scenarios (collateral_value < debt_value), the ctoken cap in liquidation_inner (L762-771) forces seized_ctokens = total_ctokens, so seized_value = total_collateral_value < total_debt_value, meaning the operator cannot profit. In non-bad-debt ADL the positive liquidation_incentive (adl.move:201-206) is intentional by design — the comment at market.move:656 explicitly acknowledges and caps it to max_liquidation_incentive rather than eliminating it, and adl_admin.move:68-69 allows admins to set a positive incentive_base_bps without an upper-bound check, confirming this is a deliberate mechanism to compensate ADL operators.
